description: Confirms that local files are uploaded and frozen as res: references before the i2i draft, restyle edits are full-replace, and upscale is routed as a separately priced flow.
expectations: Local images are ingested via resource upload and referenced as res:<lowercaseUuid>; file:// and uri: refs are rejected
The i2i draft requires at least one image-bearing reference
Restyle via node edit image provides the complete new generation block (full replace), not a partial diff
Upscale is separately priced: node confirm tokens are invalid for node upscale image
Model / ratio / resolution values come only from the live discovery payload; legacy v1.4.18 tokens are never reused
Paid execution is handed off to dreamina-canvas-cli; this Skill never calls --run
Exit 20 / 21 continue via operation wait with the same submitId
